page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz. The processor architecture is x86_64 and includes 35 MB of L3 cache, along with support for AVX-512 vector extensions and Intel Deep Learning Boost (AVX512_VNNI). The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.g6.8xlarge in the average tier for multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. While single-core performance in stress-ng and gzip compression is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% of tested servers, its multi-core capabilities scale effectively. The instance achieves average ratings in Geekbench multi-core tests, Passmark CPU benchmarks, and Redis SET operations. Memory bandwidth is measured at 108.04 GB/sec for large block reads and 47.67 GB/sec for large block writes, aligning with standard mid-tier memory performance.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6.8xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation and moderate memory density without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The lack of local storage requires external block storage configuration, which should be factored into the overall architecture. It is well-suited for general-purpose workloads such as web serving, application servers, database operations, and software compilation.

Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, it features AVX-512 support and a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, though it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Benchmark data indicates average multi-core CPU and memory performance, contrasted by weaker single-core execution speeds. This resource profile makes the ecs.g6.8xlarge a reliable option for balanced workloads such as application servers, mid-sized databases, and general-purpose web serving where dedicated compute resources are required without extreme memory or storage demands.
